svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.29k stars in total, about 1.81k a year earlier. jactionlint 319, mr boxington 720, aube 2062, fnox 2366, hk 1307, pitchfork 713, usage 1075, +6 more 723.
